prompt: Use case illustration-story. One clean landscape 16:9 educational illustration about seeing daylight and moonlight, for Chinese first graders. One balanced diptych in an original gentle gouache children's book style on warm textured paper. Left half bright pale blue daytime sky with ONE large clearly circular golden sun above a few quiet distant hills. Right half deep indigo dusk sky with ONE large pale warm-white crescent moon above the same simple distant hills. Split only by a soft clean vertical seam at the center, no borders or frames. Sun at the left half center, moon at the right half center, both completely visible and comparably sized for side-by-side discussion. Broad, uncluttered shapes, cream, indigo, warm honey, faint greens. No text, character glyphs, numerals, stars near the moon, logos, UI, watermark, or extra sun/moon shapes.
review: 左侧白昼有一轮太阳，右侧夜色有一弯月，色彩和轮廓分明；裁切留足，未含文字或其它天体，适合解释构字联想。
